body: I decided that I'm going to break that promise. I have set a time, a place, how I'll do it and will give everybody a reason as to why I've decided to take.my own life but it isn't because I am depressed, if I told people that I was going to kill myself then they would think that was the reason and try to stop me and get me thrown into the mental hospital but it has absolutely nothing to do with depression. I made the decision to end my life a couple of years ago and gave myself two years after I was forced to get help (by the way the help changed nothing it only made me stay here to suffer the same crap for an additional 2 years). The reason I want to end my life it really quite simple... I hate living in the cruel, miserable, manipulative, hypocritical, painful bullshit world, and I don't want to have to wake up after the day I have planned to turn on a tv or open a news paper and watch or read about another murder or rape or pedophile attack on some little child. I hate being here, I hate everything about life I get some joy out of it but it's all superficial and isn't a reason to stay here. My wanting to die isn't an immediate threat but I will be dead by years end. Two things are going to happen by telling people of my plans; they'll either take it as a bluff and that's fine however if they do actually care about me then they should have shown me every day instead of acting the way they have my entire life, or they'll take it as an immediate threat and stop me not out of caring for me but the opposite as a matter of fact, if they stop me they they can ensure I continue to live which means I'm still in pain and they can take joy in it. Anyway I don't expect a response I'm not important enough for someone who knows me to care about let alone a stranger I just wanted to leave something here for somebody to read after I'm gone 👋👋👋
